name: @stewardmd/capacitor-whisper
description: On-device Whisper (whisper.cpp) speech-to-text for MaiK Scribe 'Clinical Dictation'. Audio never leaves the device — only recognized text is returned. Fully offline after a one-time model download.
author: StewardMD
_vendored: StewardMD-authored local plugin (SPM on iOS like capacitor-vision-ocr). Links whisper.cpp v1.9.1 (MIT). No JS dist — accessed via Capacitor.Plugins.Whisper. ANDROID RE-ACTIVATED 2026-08-14 (owner: on-device Whisper is the production ASR target on Android too, not just iOS). The android NDK/JNI build (whisper.cpp) adds ~6MB to the arm64 APK + a slow first native compile, accepted for offline clinical ASR. If you ever need to disable it again, remove the "android" capacitor entry + the android/* files entries and re-run `npx cap sync android`. whisper.cpp is a nested git submodule at android/src/main/cpp/whisper-cpp (v1.9.1) — run `git submodule update --init --recursive` if empty.
